name: HFSP Cross-Disciplinary Fellowship
amount: Living allowance + research and travel allowance (amounts by host country); child, parental leave and relocation allowances
other_rules: Doctorate in a non-biological field (physics, chemistry, mathematics, engineering, computer science etc.) with little or no life-science experience
same nationality, mobility, supervisor, publication and timing rules as the Long-Term Fellowship
one HFSP fellowship application per year
notes: Same 2027 cycle dates as the Long-Term Fellowship.
